roles.mission: Study exact catalog, approved art board and Corona direction. Establish silhouette, materials, composition and target quality. Give art specifications to the producer; no redesign of rules.

Author a genuinely new editable crown/illustration with visually intentional forms, layered metalwork, embossed Valoria heraldry and amber/amethyst accents, realistic materials, asymmetric wear, and cinematic depth. Use Blender tool operations or original image creation only under a distinct approved budget. Produce native editable .blend, original illustration PNG, separate source and provenance. Do not merely reuse a flat mockup.

Use existing Blender MCP and Unity MCP connections when a real safe session is available. Query capability and verify actual responses before action. Only approved typed action adapter, scratch project and file scope; no arbitrary code generated by a role. Prepare alpha-correct sprites, texture color space, material and import evidence. Native Windows is currently reserved, so hosted Blender is an explicitly labelled fallback, not MCP proof.

Reuse actual Relicario V2.5 master with a true legendary frame, art window, N8 E6 S7 O7 in dynamic plaques, effect from source, independent title and seal. UI text localization; no new catalog entry or effects. Unity native test scene only with safe lease; first validate exact versioned template at mobile and compact board size.

Inspect actual renders and rendered cards at 640x1024 and 265x424; compare richness, proportions, hierarchy, material response, fidelity to approved art direction, readable numbers and effect. Reject generic primitive look, gold plastic, overdecorated noisy borders, occluded art and typography. Do not declare ART_APPROVED by technical tests.

geometry_and_art: Editable Blender source with authored crown mesh, relief, gemstones, coherent material response and final render; no baked game text/numbers.
Separate RGBA frame and Indestructible overlay; original frame from candidate reference PR189 reused, not new approved production asset.
Normal legendaria and visual-only Indestructible share exact dimensions and data; title and text live; 390x844 and compact 320x720, 430x932, master 640x1024 and 3x3 board scale.

acceptance.native: Separate Unity scene in scratch project only, exact Unity 6.3 if reachable. Validate UI Sprite Image.Type.Simple preserveAspect, live TextMeshPro/uGUI values, alpha, atlas only if profiled. Capture portrait and landscape. No claims until actual Unity/MCP response.
